name: Sailani Tours N Travels Limited
summary: Sailani Tours N Travels Limited is an Indian enterprise offering a comprehensive array of travel and tourism solutions. The company's services span flight and hotel reservations, bespoke domestic and international holiday packages, MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, and Exhibitions) services, currency exchange, visa facilitation, and travel insurance. They design personalized itineraries for both popular tourist destinations and more offbeat locations. Furthermore, their offerings are accessible for online purchase. Established in 2019, Sailani Tours N Travels is based in Kolkata, India.
